description: Font sizes are not tokenized. ~70+ raw font-size values (rem and clamp) are hardcoded across 13 module CSS files (every page plus Nav, Footer, QuickLinkCard, admin, gate, rsvp); only font-family is tokenized today and there is no type-scale token. Define a type-scale token set in the single theme config (the surface 2bfe establishes) and sweep the CSS modules to reference it, per the architect's scale design. Extend the token-style rule/adherence rubric to cover font-size so the fix stays enforced.
title: Tokenize font sizes into a theme type scale
acceptance_criteria: A type-scale token set lives in the single theme config alongside the color roles and font families.
No raw font-size values remain in component/page CSS modules; every font-size references a scale token.
Existing clamp()-based fluid headings are preserved per the architect's scale design (no visual regression on home/details/travel/admin headings).
The token-style adherence rubric is extended to flag raw font-size values, and passes on the swept code.
design-reviewer confirms no visual regression across guest-facing pages and admin.
